title: OpenAI says California should strengthen its AI safety bill
summary: OpenAI is calling for California to strengthen SB 53, an AI safety bill that the company previously opposed.
llm_summary: OpenAI, which previously lobbied against California’s SB 53 AI‑risk bill, is now urging the state to tighten the legislation rather than weaken it. The company argues that stronger safeguards—such as broader definitions of “high‑risk” AI systems and stricter oversight requirements—are needed to protect consumers and mitigate potential harms.
